title: Supportive Helixor® therapy for advanced tumor diseases of the mammary gland and gynecological and gastrointestinal organs
summary: The aim of this observational study is to gain insights into Helixor® therapy under the practical conditions of outpatient oncological care. The main focus here is on fatigue (exhaustion, tiredness), quality of life in general, temperature regulation and the sensation of warmth. The occurrence of side effects under this therapy will also be recorded.
conditions: Malignant neoplasms of female genital organs

interventions.name: As part of this observational study, routine treatment data is recorded and analyzed at four points of observation (PO 1: after the decision for and before the first administration of Helixor®, PO 2: one month after PO 1, PO 3: three months after PO 1, PO 4: six months after PO 1). This involves the

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Advanced tumor diseases of the mammary gland, gynaecological organs, or gastrointestinal organs (stage IV, M1).
- New start of Helixor® therapy. In the case of previous mistletoe therapy, this must have been completed before the first point of observation.
Exclusion criteria:
- Other than subcutaneous application of mistletoe preparations (e.g. intravenous infusions).
- Contraindication for Helixor® therapy.
